text.app.name: Nemura
text.signin.title: Sign in
text.signin.lead: Sign in with your company account. Nemura never asks for your NRIC to sign in.
text.signin.none: No way to sign in is set up yet. Ask whoever runs Nemura for your company.
text.signin.notSetUp: Nemura is not set up yet. The person who installs it creates the first organisation with the one-time setup code; after that you can sign in.
text.signin.invite: New here? Your company sends you an invitation. Open it after you sign in.
text.signin.loading: Checking how you can sign in
text.signin.failed: We could not reach Nemura. Check your connection and try again.
text.signin.art.lead: Your leave, your pay, your letters. One place.
text.signin.art.label: About Nemura
text.signin.art.leave: Apply for leave in under a minute
text.signin.art.letters: Letters for the bank, a landlord or a visa
text.home.noRoles: You have no role yet. Ask the Owner to give you one.
text.home.soon: Your leave, pay and letters appear here as each is switched on for your company.
text.notfound.title: There is nothing at this address
text.notfound.fix: Go to your home page and start again.
text.review.heading: Needs additional verification
text.signin.error.NM_SIGNIN_01: That way of signing in does not exist. Choose one of the buttons below.
text.signin.error.NM_SIGNIN_02: The sign-in took too long, or started in another browser. Start again here.
text.signin.error.NM_SIGNIN_03: The sign-in provider's answer did not pass its checks. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell whoever runs Nemura.
text.signin.error.NM_SIGNIN_04: We could not reach the sign-in provider. Try again in a moment.
text.signin.error.NM_SIGNIN_05: Your account is not a member of any organisation here. Ask your company for an invitation, then choose I have an invitation.
text.signin.error.NM_SIGNIN_06: Sign-out was sent from another site. Sign out from Nemura itself.
text.signin.error.NM_SIGNIN_07: Nemura is not set up yet. Choose Set up Nemura and use the one-time setup code.
text.signin.error.NM_SIGNIN_08: That code is wrong, was used already or has expired. Check it, or ask for a new one.
text.join.lead.setup: The person who installs Nemura creates the first organisation with the one-time setup code, and becomes its Owner.
text.join.lead.invitation: Use the code in your invitation. It works once, for you, and expires.
text.join.name: Your name
text.join.help: You sign in with the provider next, and the code is used once, with the account you sign in with.
text.join.noProvider: No way to sign in is set up yet. Ask whoever runs Nemura.
text.join.lead.recovery: Two operators of this installation issued you a one-time recovery code. Sign in with the account you will keep from now on: every other sign-in, session and passkey of yours ends.
text.directory.title: People
text.directory.lead: Everyone who works here today, with their job and manager.
text.directory.name: Name
text.directory.empty: Nobody works here yet. The HR team adds people.
text.directory.failed: We could not load the people. Check your connection and try again.
text.person.notfound: There is no such person, or you may not see their record.
text.person.title: Job title
text.features.title: Features
text.features.lead: Switch what Nemura does for your company. Switching a feature off keeps its records.
text.features.failed: We could not save that. Check your connection and try again.
text.features.none: You may not see the feature switches.
text.new.title: Add a person
text.new.lead: Add someone to the people record. Their job starts on their start date; change it later from their record.
text.new.failed: We could not add the person. Check your connection and try again.
text.packs.title: Country pack
text.packs.lead: The statutory facts Nemura uses, each with the official page it comes from. A value that is only researched has not been checked by a second person: your company decides whether to use it.
text.packs.notice: Accepting a version verifies nothing: the pack's publisher does.
text.packs.none: You may not see the packs.
text.packs.failed: We could not save that. Check your connection and try again.
text.policy.title: Leave policy
text.policy.lead: Your company's entitlements. Each is checked against the statute: giving less is refused, giving more is welcome.
text.policy.annual: Annual leave days by year of service
text.policy.annual.help: Separate days with commas: the first year, the second, and so on. The last repeats.
text.policy.outpatient: Outpatient sick leave days at 3, 4, 5 and 6 months
text.policy.hospital: Hospitalisation leave days at 3, 4, 5 and 6 months
text.policy.extended: Extended childcare leave, citizen child 7 to 12
text.checks.title: What needs a look
text.leave.title: My leave
text.leave.lead: Your balance for the year and how it was worked out. The days come from the country pack and your company's policy.
text.leave.noTypes: No leave has been granted for this year yet.
text.leave.carriedUntil: Carried-forward days can be taken until {date}.
text.leave.carried: Carried {carried} days into the next year.

text.apply.title: Apply for leave
text.apply.lead: Choose the days. The form shows what the request costs, your balance after it and who in your team is away, before you send it.
text.apply.halfStart: Only half of the first day
text.apply.halfEnd: Only half of the last day
text.apply.sent: Sent. Your manager has been told, and {days} days are reserved until they decide.
text.apply.cost: This request costs {days} days. After it you have {left} days left.
text.apply.beyond: That is more than your balance: after it you would have {left} days. Ask for fewer days.
text.apply.away: Away in your team on those days

text.team.title: Team leave
text.team.lead: Requests waiting for your decision, and what you decided lately.
text.team.refused: Refused, and the person is told why.

text.team.failed: We could not save that. Check your connection and try again.
text.sick.title: Tell us you're sick
text.sick.lead: Sick leave is not applied for: tell the company, and give the medical certificate when you are back. Nobody approves it.
text.sick.told: The company has been told. {days} working days: {paid} are paid sick leave and {unpaid} are beyond your limit.
text.sick.late: It was told more than 48 hours after the first day, so it is marked late.
text.sick.none: You have not told the company about any sick leave.
text.sick.waiting: Waiting for the people team to verify.

text.calendar.title: The month at a glance
text.calendar.none: Nobody you may see is in the calendar.
text.calendar.failed: The calendar could not be shown.
text.calendar.key: A is away, L is leave, P is a request waiting, S is sick leave and H is a public holiday.
text.gov.title: Government-paid leave
text.gov.lead: Each block of maternity, paternity or shared parental leave with its claim deadline and the employer's claims. Claims are filed on the Government-Paid Leave portal by a person; Nemura keeps the record and moves no money.
text.gov.failed: We could not show that. Check your connection and try again.
text.gov.guide: The scheme's cap suggests the Government reimburses at most S$ {amount}; the portal decides.

text.gov.eventFor: Answer to the claim filed on {on}
text.gov.order: The child's order (1 for a first child)
text.requests.title: My requests
text.requests.lead: Where your requests are: leave and flexible work. A flexible work request is a formal one: the company answers it in writing within two months.

text.flexteam.title: Flexible work requests
text.flexteam.none: No flexible work request is waiting.
text.flexteam.sent: Replied. The record of the written reply is kept.
text.ot.title: Hours worked on special days
text.ot.lead: For Part IV employees: overtime, work on a rest day and work on a public holiday, entered by the day. Your manager or the people team approves it, and a pay run uses it once.
text.ot.over: This month's overtime is beyond the monthly limit. It stays recorded and is paid, and the people team is told.

text.inputs.title: What the next pay run takes from leave and time

text.accrual.title: Month-end leave accrual
text.accrual.lead: The carried-forward annual leave still untaken, per person. Nemura keeps the days; the amounts and the journal come from payroll and the Fyniq link.

signin.page.label: Sign in
signin.page.tooltip: Sign in to Nemura with the account your company set up. A passkey confirms it is you for sensitive changes, not to sign in.

home.me.label: My home
home.me.tooltip: Where you start: your own leave, pay and letters, and what waits for you.

home.people.label: People home
home.people.tooltip: Where the people team starts: who is away, what waits for approval and the checks that need you.

nav.signOut.label: Sign out
nav.signOut.tooltip: Ends this session on this device. Other devices stay signed in until you sign out there.

review.awaiting-verification.label: Needs additional verification
review.awaiting-verification.tooltip: The rules this page uses have not had their second review yet. Check what it shows before you rely on it.

join.page.label: Join
join.page.tooltip: Take your place in Nemura with the code you were given: an invitation's, or the one-time setup code for the first organisation.

directory.page.label: People
directory.page.tooltip: Everyone who works here on a day, with their job, department and manager. Nothing restricted is shown here.

person.page.label: A person
person.page.tooltip: One person's record: contact, job history and, for the people team, their legal classification. A job change starts a new record from a day; it never edits the old one.

features.page.label: Features
features.page.tooltip: Each optional feature is on, off, or held by another system. A feature another one needs cannot be switched off, and switching off keeps the records.

new.page.label: Add a person
new.page.tooltip: Adds a person with their first job from their start date. Only the HR officer and the HR administrator add people.

packs.page.label: Country pack
packs.page.tooltip: The statutory facts Nemura uses, with the official page of each. Researched values have not been checked by a second person; your company records a decision to use them.

policy.page.label: Leave policy
policy.page.tooltip: Your company's leave entitlements on top of the statute. A policy that gives less than the statute for any rule is refused, naming the rule.

leave.page.label: My leave
leave.page.tooltip: Your leave balance for the year: entitled, taken, booked and left, with the steps of the calculation and where each figure comes from.

apply.page.label: Apply for leave
apply.page.tooltip: Ask for leave in under a minute: see the cost, your balance after the request and who else is away, then send it to your manager.

team.page.label: Team leave
team.page.tooltip: Approve or refuse the leave your reports asked for. A refusal needs a reason; you cannot decide your own request.

sick.page.label: Tell us you're sick
sick.page.tooltip: Tell the company you are sick: no approval. Paid days come out of the sick leave limit in force each day; give the medical certificate when you are back.

gov.page.label: Government-paid leave
gov.page.tooltip: Maternity, paternity and shared parental leave under the country pack's rules, with the employer's reimbursement claims and their deadlines. Nothing here moves money.

requests.page.label: My requests
requests.page.tooltip: Your leave and flexible work requests and where each is. A formal flexible work request is answered in writing within two months.

ot.page.label: Hours worked
ot.page.tooltip: Overtime, rest-day and public-holiday work for Part IV employees, entered by the day without clocking and approved before a pay run uses it.

letters.page.label: Letters
letters.page.tooltip: Requests for letters. The people team checks each one; the signatory signs the exact PDF with a passkey, and the letter is kept as evidence.

request.page.label: Ask for a letter
request.page.tooltip: Ask for an employment confirmation or another letter. It shows only facts of your record and needs the people team's check and the signatory's signature.

terms.page.label: Key employment terms
terms.page.tooltip: The terms the Employment Act asks the employer to give in writing within 14 days of the start. The people team writes the base terms; only the Payroll administrator and the Owner see and write the pay.

tpl.page.label: Letter templates
tpl.page.tooltip: Set the letterhead, switch letter types on and write their templates. A template is a draft until the HR administrator approves it; a published version never changes.
